description: Upstream normal/nuisance labels remain the basis. Deterministic rules generate provisional labels; versioned exact-record P0/P1 golden adjudications and exact P2 adjudications resolve reviewed cases without generalizing to unseen records. normal->direct_nuisance remains never-auto in compatibility mode.

reactive_matching.note: This intentionally mirrors the documented first-pass mechanism. Normalization may be used later for filter-keyword analysis, but not for compatibility labeling.

review_priorities.1: Likely missed reactive context; mandatory adjudication for strict finalization.
review_priorities.2: Potential upstream normal/nuisance boundary issue; informative unless a full relabel is explicitly authorized.

strict_finalization.priority_2_behavior: report_but_do_not_fail; exact reviewed P2 decisions may resolve individual cases without changing the publication gate
strict_finalization.publication_behavior: three_class_labeled.json is published only when unresolved P0/P1 count is zero
strict_finalization.candidate_output: three_class_candidate.json is always written for inspectable intermediate results

historical_reference.known_gap: The prior run contained 41 normal-candidate exclusions and 1 nuisance-candidate exclusion whose complete exception code was not recoverable. v1.4.0 does not claim to reconstruct those exceptions; its golden registry is a new, explicit spec-guided adjudication set.

review_resolution.priority_0_1: golden exact-case adjudication or explicit manual override with non-empty note required
review_resolution.priority_2: versioned exact-case P2 adjudication may resolve a P2-only case; unresolved P2 remains optional and does not block publication
review_resolution.p2_manual_conflict: manual override of a P2-registry key is an error

golden_adjudication.identity: record_key = SHA-256(first 24 hex) over five fields + Stage13 label
golden_adjudication.precedence: golden_adjudication > provisional_rule; manual overrides are rejected for golden keys

p2_adjudication.identity: same exact record_key used by 3-Class golden adjudication
p2_adjudication.scope: P2-only exact records where review reasons are exactly source_normal_direct_cue
p2_adjudication.precedence: P0/P1 golden registry and P2 registry must not overlap; a P2 registry decision overrides the provisional label for that exact case; manual overrides are rejected for P2 keys
